## Implementation pushed — Gerrit change 1374

Fix (per the ratified fail-closed ruling): `epic_bug_screen` now RE-RAISES `LLMUnavailableError` (subclass `LLMConfigError` included by design) from the warm call, the fan-out (`screen_candidates._row`), and `run_screen`'s advisory shield, instead of degrading to C. The workflow interpreter fails the precheck step and the close gate's existing fail-closed handler blocks the close, naming the provider failure; `--force-close` remains the escape hatch. Non-systemic failures keep degrade-open.

TDD trail: 4 RED-first tests (warm-call, fan-out, run_screen, completion_precheck propagation — all failed on unmodified main with the provider error laundered to C), plus a gate-seam refusal test (nonzero exit, in_progress, 'ValidationException' named, unsigned) and a non-provider-still-degrades pin. Mutation check: stashing the fix returns the 4 propagation tests to RED. Targeted suites green (500 lifecycle/close-gate/screen tests), `make lint` + `make typecheck` clean. Change-1360 behavior (grandfathering, certifiable=False stderr warn, PASS sidecar) untouched and its tests green.

Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on change 1374 before Submit.
